tool_config.name: focus_region
tool_config.description: Pan the board to a region of the homework. Use it before talking about a problem the student can't currently see.

region_id.description: ID of the region, exactly as listed, such as p1.q3.

tool_config.name: circle_region
tool_config.description: Circle a region of the homework in the tutor's color. Use it as you start talking about that problem.

region_id.description: ID of the region, exactly as listed, such as p1.q3.

tool_config.name: draw_arrow
tool_config.description: Draw an arrow between two regions to show how they relate.

from_region_id.description: ID of the region the arrow starts at.

to_region_id.description: ID of the region the arrow points to.

label.description: Optional short label for the arrow, a few words at most.

tool_config.name: write_text
tool_config.description: Write a short hint in the margin beside a region. Use it for hints only, never for a final answer.

near_region_id.description: ID of the region the note belongs beside.

text.description: The note, a few words in the session's language.

tool_config.name: write_math
tool_config.description: Write a short equation in the margin beside a region. Use it for hints only, never for a final answer.

near_region_id.description: ID of the region the equation belongs beside.

latex.description: The equation as LaTeX. Never read this aloud.

tool_config.name: clear
tool_config.description: Remove the tutor's own marks from the board. The student's work stays. Use it when moving to a different problem.
